businesses.business: Gaming terminal operations and equipment sales

offering_description.value: Accel supplies video gaming terminals, redemption machines and amusement devices to bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops, and fraternal and veterans’ organizations. It operates games and provides compliance and operational guidance through venue partnerships.

quotes.quote: Accel Entertainment partners with bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops, and fraternal and veteran organizations nationwide to provide high-quality video gaming terminals, redemption machines, and amusement devices. Our mission is to help our partners grow their business by delivering a turn-key solution that includes industry-leading customer support, regulatory compliance expertise, and hands-on operational guidance to ensure they maximize revenue and enhance their customer experience.

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing and regulation of gaming terminal operations, including operator licensing in Pennsylvania

quotes.quote: Pennsylvania – Accel is a Licensed Operator

At Accel Entertainment, we believe that gaming should always be safe, enjoyable, and responsibly managed. We are committed to promoting responsible gaming practices across all of our partner establishments and ensuring compliance with all state regulations. Through employee training, on-site signage, and access to support resources, we help players make informed decisions and seek help when needed. We’re proud to work alongside our partners to maintain a safe and responsible gaming environment in every community we serve.
